summary: Three observable requirements are grounded in the supplied brief.

requirements.description: Emit explicit column order and headers.
requirements.acceptance: Empty input still emits the specified header; records follow columns in order with CRLF separators and trailing CRLF.
Fields containing commas, quotes, CR, or LF are quoted; embedded quotes are doubled; null and missing values become empty fields.

requirements.description: Preserve input and reject invalid top-level arguments.
requirements.acceptance: Frozen records and columns serialize without mutation; non-array rows or columns throws TypeError.
